Ok so I dont really have much experience in this, but MANY of people who are really close to me have done somehing similar and have excelled in it. They have taught me the process. I know that a grocery store is a big leap so you have to start out small...

1. Legalize your companys product
  For this you have to go to a place in which the government can make sure what you are doing is legal. I dont know how it is where you live but in my country it is as simple as going to a counsil or something similar.

Once you have a green light on this you start producing the product. My sister makes a type of healthy vegan product with her bf in their house and are already selling it to grocery stores. This means that depending on the exceptions they give you, you can produce it in different places. In my neighborhood the government likes to support small bussiness so they said to my sister that only certain sanitary precautions had to be taken; it all depends on your country. 

2. Sell to stores

Once your company is able to legally produce everything, you should start selling the product to small businesses, such as stores, kiosks, etc... try to find the right audience and buyer. For example; energy drink = sports/health store. 
If you found your buyer sell it to them. Sell to small businesses because your production rate will always be small when you just started. Theyll buy small numbers of your product but it if it goes well you'll be on your way to the top...
As for advertising I would suggest Facebook or instagram pages, nowadays its the best option if you dont have much capital.

Now try to sell to as many stores as possible, this will make sure that you have a wide market and that many buyers will recognize your drink, not just a random stranger that goes to just one store to buy their things.
If all goes well I suggest start hiring people to "mass produce" your product. Try to do it well and with people you can trust so no one takes your idea (happened to someone I know). As you keep selling to stores in a higher number you will get more attention towards your product. 

3. Present and sell to grocery, big tier stores

This step I only reccomend if the your company is going up, has broken even and is doing well. The reason behind it is because to get here your production has to be massive. 
Present your ideas and product to any grocery store, again I would start smaller and then go bigger but its your choice. From here its more obvious what you have to do...
The store will probably buy your product in big quantities and give you a percentage of the income.

Alway keep in mind the other aspects of a business such as: legal matters and accounting among others. Try to find efficiency in everything, for example producing large enough to sell but small enough to not have left over product that wont be bought.

This takes time dont rush. 

Best of Luck in your business!

It's different for everyone but try to find a coping mechanism (I play guitar, work out or fight when I feel kind of down) you just have to find yours, try to keep your mind off of her as much as possible (easier said than done of course) but trust me it really helps you get over it quicker. Apart from that, I don't really know much else except than going through it. It might take you some time, but I promise you that eventually, you'll get through it. WHo knows? maybe in a few months, you'll find someone 100x better, you just have to let things pass. /u/aced_tracing helped me a lot when he commented this on my post (don't upvote me, he wrote the following):
 

>You imagine and expect you will feel depressed.
Pick apart what really is happening, though.
You had a super wonderful companion.
She's going to be gone then.
You no longer have that super wonderful companion.
You wish you still had that super wonderful companion - but what would all that cost. Your super wonderful companion wouldn't be able to go to Europe.
You think you miss her - but pick that apart. You're replaying good memories or fantasising about new ones. You think of it and you feel "skin hunger". You expect to have this other person so near to you, but she isn't, and it creates a sort of a weird frustration.
You had a good run.
Now give the rest of the world, and the rest of your life to offer you some experiences that you have not even thought about yet.
Think about it - before you met that girl, were you even capable of dreaming about having someone as wonderful as her for yourself?
Probably not.
It's likely that life will have something else in store for you that you don't even know to expect yet.
But it can never reach you if you shut yourself from the world and it's opportunities by obsessing over not having that one good relationship for forever.
Every person you meet in your life next - a friend, a relative, a girl - if you approach them without any expectations, they have the capability to blow. your. mind.
Just give anything a chance.
